text:
Below are four statements about different isotopes of a certain element.
Which statement must be true?
A
They have a different number of electrons.
B
They have the same number of neutrons.
C
They have the same number of nucleons.
D
They have the same number of protons.

options.label: A
options.text: They have a different number of electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: They have the same number of neutrons.

options.label: C
options.text: They have the same number of nucleons.

options.label: D
options.text: They have the same number of protons.
